title: Refuse mixed Ticket trailers on a branch at preflight
body:
Outcome: a branch whose commits carry more than one distinct Ticket trailer is refused at preflight (scripts/head-trailers.mjs or a new check), not first at `krn deliver`.
Evidence: #150 (t-a8v7yp9) carried d96dbe2 with `Ticket: t-gnydgbs`; after a PASS third panel `krn deliver --dry-run` exited 73 "PR commits require exactly one matching Ticket trailer" (src/deliver/message.ts:22). The reviewed head could not be rewritten, so the lead shipped by hand (statuses, gate, ready, ship) — .krn/runs/delivery-loop/session-continuity/pr150-decision.md Outcome.
Proof: an observer that fails at the base by assertion: preflight on a fixture branch with two distinct Ticket trailers exits non-zero naming both commits; a single-ticket branch passes.
